# Service-principal deliveries into an SQS queue encrypted with alias/aws/sqs whose queue
# policy allows sns/events/s3 (us-east-1, 2026-11-11). All resources deleted afterwards.
### queue
$ aws sqs create-queue --queue-name fc-svcp-0b86a341 --attributes {"KmsMasterKeyId": "alias/aws/sqs", "Policy": "{\"Version\": \"2012-10-17\", \"Statement\": [{\"Effect\": \"Allow\", \"Principal\": {\"Service\": [\"sns.amazonaws.com\", \"events.amazonaws.com\", \"s3.amazonaws.com\"]}, \"Action\": \"sqs:SendMessage\", \"Resource\": \"arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:123456789012:fc-svcp-0b86a341\", \"Condition\": {\"StringEquals\": {\"aws:SourceAccount\": \"123456789012\"}}}]}"}
{
    "QueueUrl": "https://sqs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/123456789012/fc-svcp-0b86a341"
}
[exit 0]
### SNS

    "TopicArn": "arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:fc-svcp-0b86a341"
}
[exit 0]
$ aws sns subscribe --topic-arn arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:fc-svcp-0b86a341 --protocol sqs --notification-endpoint arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:123456789012:fc-svcp-0b86a341 --attributes RawMessageDelivery=true

[exit 0]
